name: @mandusec/agent-sdk-host-fixture
description: Two small host programs built on the agent SDKs (the Claude Agent SDK and the Codex SDK), pinned, that agent-sdk.test.ts runs under the real launcher (docs/design/agents/agent-sdks.md). .npmrc omits the optional per-platform CLI binaries, so the hosts run the claude and codex on PATH unless the bundled ones are installed (npm ci --include=optional).
